item.title: [6.8] Big US bank stocks head for longest weekly losing streak since 2008
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Major US banks are experiencing their longest weekly losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis, driven by mixed quarterly earnings and rising inflation.
